description: Two bare-chested men in white linen kilts kneel at a large round carved board with a spiral track, moving small figures on it; a coiled serpent is carved at the centre, and pebbles sit around the rim. Behind them, several men stand watching in a dim, lamp-lit room with a stone wall, a wooden table with an oil lamp, and a small lamp with smoke rising on the mat in front of the board. The dress and setting look ancient Egyptian. There is no visible text, number, frame or border; the painting runs edge to edge. Nothing is gory.
